title: Tournament-GRPO: Group-Wise Tournament Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Open-Ended Long-Form Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.26958v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning in open-ended long-form generation is challenging because reliable reference answers and automatic metrics are often unavailable. Existing rubric-based methods typically rely on pointwise LLM-as-a-judge scoring, but absolute scores are difficult to calibrate across complex responses, may provide weak discrimination among same-query rollouts, and can become saturated during optimization. We propose Tournament-GRPO, a group-wise reward framework that converts rubric-guided LLM judgments into relative rewards through repeated multi-round tournaments among same-query rollouts. Tournament-GRPO compares candidates within groups, accumulates tournament outcomes, and normalizes them into group-wise rewards for GRPO training. Experiments on Deep Research Bench show that Tournament-GRPO consistently outperforms existing reward-design baselines, achieving a 4.52-point overall-score improvement over the strongest bas

translated_title: 锦标赛-GRPO：面向开放式长文本生成强化学习的组间锦标赛奖励机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.26958v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：在开放式长文本生成中进行强化学习具有挑战性，因为可靠的参考答案和自动评估指标通常不可用。现有的基于评分规则的方法通常依赖于点式LLM作为裁判的评分，但绝对分数在复杂回答中难以校准，可能在同一查询的生成结果中提供较弱的区分度，并且在优化过程中可能饱和。我们提出锦标赛-GRPO，一种组间奖励框架，通过在同一查询的生成结果之间进行多轮锦标赛，将基于评分规则的LLM判断转换为相对奖励。锦标赛-GRPO在组内比较候选者，累积锦标赛结果，并将其归一化为用于GRPO训练的组间奖励。在深度研究基准上的实验表明，锦标赛-GRPO持续优于现有的奖励设计基线，相对于最强基线实现了4.52分的总体得分提升。
tldr: 锦标赛-GRPO通过组内多轮锦标赛将LLM判断转化为相对奖励，解决了开放式长文本生成中绝对评分校准困难的问题，在深度研究基准上显著优于现有基线。
en_tdlr: Tournament-GRPO converts LLM judgments into relative rewards via group-wise multi-round tournaments, addressing calibration issues of absolute scoring in open-ended long-form generation, and achieves a 4.52-point improvement over the strongest baseline on Deep Research Bench.
